newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-CROATIA AND TURKEY DRAW IN KIRIN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIA AND TURKEY DRAW IN KIRIN CUP.

text.p: Turkey midfielder Ertugrul Saglam scored a second-half equaliser on Thursday as Turkey and Croatia drew 1-1 in the three-nation Kirin Cup tournament.

Turkey's Hajduk Split forward Tomislav Erceg headed in his first international goal to give Croatia a 21st minute lead before Saglam headed home a cross from Hakan Unsal in the 77th minute at Sendai stadium, northeast of Tokyo.
Croatia, which lost to Japan 4-3 in Tokyo on Sunday, finished the tournament with one draw and one loss while Turkey will meet Japan in Osaka next Sunday.
A crowd of 15,687 watched a lacklustre rematch of the two nations' clash in last June's European championship in England, where quarterfinalist Croatia beat Turkey 1-0 in the preliminary round.
Both countries had under-strength sides, missing several key players crucial to their current European qualifying campaigns for the World Cup finals in France next year.
